Film room / ethosAI

Model evaluation, one slide at a time.

Through ethosAI, I help evaluate how a leading frontier AI lab’s model creates slides. A typical task gives me several versions of the same slide. I compare them, explain what works, and flag generic language, weak hierarchy, clutter, and other patterns that make an output feel like AI slop.
